item.title: "Is President Lee trying to become the supreme dignity?"...Jang Dong-hyuk criticizes the manipulated indictment special counsel law with red-baiting rhetoric. (“이 대통령, 최고존엄 되려하나”…장동혁, 색깔론으로 조작기소 특검법 비판)
item.description:
Jang Dong-hyuk, the leader of the People Power Party, has repeatedly compared President Lee Jae-myung to North Korean leader Kim Jong-un, the General Secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea and Chairman of the State Affairs Commission, employing red-baiting tactics. (장동혁 국민의힘 대표가 이재명 대통령을 연일 김정은 북한 조선노동당 총비서 겸 국무위원장에 빗대며 색깔론을 꺼내 들었다.)

At the party's Supreme Council meeting held at the National Assembly on the 4th, Representative Jang said, "There's only one person on the Korean Peninsula who won't go to prison no matter what crime they commit. That's North Korea's supreme dignity, Kim Jong-un." He added, "It seems there will be one more now. Does President Lee Jae-myung want to become 'Supreme Dignity No. 2'?" (장 대표는 4일 국회에서 열린 당 최고위원회의에서 “무슨 죄를 지어도 감옥에 안 가는 사람이 한반도에 딱 한명 있다. 북한 최고존엄 김정은”이라며 “이제 한명 더 늘어날 것 같다. 이재명 대통령은 ‘최고존엄 넘버2’가 되고 싶은 건가”라고 말했다.)

Representative Jang also criticized the 'Manipulated Indictment Special Counsel Law,' proposed by the Democratic Party, calling it "a law that exists for only one person," and stated, "This isn't a law; it's violence and a crime. They might as well enact the 'Lee Jae-myung Supreme Dignity Law.'" The previous day, at the opening ceremony of the election office for People Power Party Daegu mayoral candidate Choo Kyung-ho, Jang had also criticized, "President Lee has long been a spokesperson for Kim Jong-un." (장 대표는 더불어민주당 주도로 발의된 ‘조작기소 특검법’이 “한 사람만을 위해 존재하는 법”이라며 “이건 법이 아니라 폭력이자 범죄다. 차라리 ‘이재명 최고존엄법’을 만들라”고도 했다. 장 대표는 전날 추경호 국민의힘 대구시장 후보 선거사무소 개소식에서도 “이 대통령은 김정은 대변인이 된 지 오래”라고 비판한 바 있다.)

The Democratic Party countered, saying, "Those who trampled on democracy are now resorting to red-baiting again without any apology or reflection." (민주당은 “민주주의를 짓밟은 이들이 사과와 반성 없이 다시 꺼낸 건 색깔론”이라고 비판했다.)

At a field Supreme Council meeting held at the Busan Port International Exhibition and Convention Center in Dong-gu, Busan, on the same day, Representative Jeong Cheong-rae stated, "Those who try to turn back the wheels of history with outdated red-baiting must face severe judgment." Kim Hyun-jung, the deputy floor spokesperson, also said in a written briefing, "After going in circles and nominating 'Yoon Again,' what they've pulled out is old, worn-out red-baiting like 'spokesperson for Kim Jong-un' and 'amendment to the socialist constitution.'" (정청래 대표는 이날 부산 동구 부산항국제전시컨벤션센터에서 열린 현장 최고위원회의에서 “낡은 색깔론으로 역사의 수레바퀴를 되돌리려는 저들에게 준엄한 심판이 있어야 한다”며 이렇게 말했다. 김현정 원내대변인도 서면 브리핑에서 “돌고 돌아 ‘윤 어게인’ 공천을 하더니 꺼내 든 것은 ‘김정은의 대변인’ ‘사회주의 헌법 개정’과 같은 낡디낡은 색깔론”이라고 했다.)

Reporter Yoo Young-jae young@hani.co.kr Reporter Ko Han-sol sol@hani.co.kr (유영재 기자 young@hani.co.kr 고한솔 기자 sol@hani.co.kr)

item.title: Choo Kyung-ho: “Chance of Guilty Verdict for Insurrection Duties? Lower than Being Struck by Lightning in Clear Sky” (추경호 “내란 중요임무 유죄? 날벼락 맞을 확률보다 낮아”)
item.description:
“Every day, I sense the scattered conservative support base rapidly consolidating. Only I, who served as Deputy Prime Minister for the Economy, can revive Daegu’s economy.” (“매일매일 흩어진 보수 지지층이 빠르게 결집하는 것을 느낀다. 경제부총리까지 한 저만이 대구 경제를 다시 살릴 수 있다.”)

Choo Kyung-ho, the People Power Party candidate for Daegu mayor, emphasized “the economy” multiple times during an interview with The Hankyoreh at his campaign office in Suseong-gu, Daegu on the 4th, saying he feels the conservatives gathering on the ground. Regarding the special counsel bill for manipulated indictments proposed by the Democratic Party, Choo stated, “Their arrogance is sky-high. The people will surely deliver a stern judgment.” He also sharply criticized his opponent, Democratic Party candidate Kim Boo-kyum, saying, “When he was prime minister, he did nothing for Daegu.” <<> Concerning his indictment without detention on charges of engaging in important duties related to insurrection, for allegedly moving the party meeting venue multiple times as the People Power Party floor leader during the December 3 martial law crisis, he strongly denied it, saying, “The probability of being found guilty is lower than the chance of being struck by lightning in a clear sky.” After visiting former President Park Geun-hye on the same day alongside Gyeongbuk Governor candidate Lee Cheol-woo of the same party, Choo reported, “Former President Park told us that Daegu must play its role as the center of conservatism.” <<> —Why are you the right person for the job? <<> “Who will revive the stagnant economy is the biggest topic in Daegu society. Having worked in economic ministries my entire life and served as Deputy Prime Minister for the Economy, I will use that experience to fulfill my role in revitalizing Daegu’s economy.” <<> —What are your key pledges? <<> “I will carry out a major reform of Daegu’s economy. I will create a city where money and people gather, and generate jobs. I will transform Daegu’s main industries into AI and future mobility advanced industries. I will make Daegu a national model startup city and establish a semiconductor cluster. There is a strong demand for competitive large corporations in the region. I will immediately launch an investment attraction team.” <<> —Democratic Party candidate Kim Boo-kyum is promoting himself as an ‘efficacious ruling party candidate.’ <<> “I question his sincerity. Citizens evaluate that when he served as prime minister and minister under the Moon Jae-in government in 2018, he did nothing for Daegu. If he couldn’t do it then, how can someone who isn’t even a key Lee Jae-myung ally accomplish it under a Lee Jae-myung administration? I see it as lip service for campaign strategy. The Daegu-Gyeongbuk administrative integration bill could have passed if the Democratic Party had decided to support it—what did he do then?” <<> —You’re trailing behind candidate Kim Boo-kyum in polls. <<> “Until the candidate was confirmed, many internal conflicts within the party were exposed. The nomination process was also not smooth, leading to public discontent. However, since the candidate was confirmed, the scattered conservative support base has been rapidly consolidating.” <<> In a survey conducted by Ace Research on behalf of Daegu MBC on the 2nd and 3rd, Democratic Party candidate Kim Boo-kyum received 45.9% support, while People Power Party candidate Choo Kyung-ho got 42.4%, narrowing the gap between the two candidates within the margin of error. (For details, refer to the National Election Survey Deliberation Commission website.) <<> —What is your strategy to overturn the election? <<> “Citizens have started to gather based on my economic capabilities, and the perception that Daegu, the heart of conservatism, must play its role is spreading.” <<> —The Democratic Party proposed a special counsel bill for manipulated indictments. <<> “I question whether this is a feasible idea under a liberal democracy. Trying to create a law to cancel an indictment is an outrage against the constitutional order. Their arrogance is sky-high. The people will surely deliver a stern judgment.” <<> —The Democratic Party is attacking you for being indicted without detention on charges of engaging in important duties related to insurrection. <<> “It’s just political manipulation of the insurrection narrative. The probability of being found guilty is lower than the chance of being struck by lightning in a clear sky. I also want to ask if the Democratic Party is qualified to attack me over judicial risks. Gyeongnam Governor candidate Kim Kyoung-soo lost his previous gubernatorial post due to the ‘Druking’ comment manipulation case, and Busan Mayor candidate Jeon Jae-soo has faced bribery allegations.” <<> —You visited former President Park Geun-hye today (4th). Do you plan to ask for her support in campaigning? <<> “This wasn’t a meeting to request campaign support. I believe former President Park will decide based on the situation.” <<> Daegu / Reporter Kim Hae-jeong sea@hani.co.kr (추경호 국민의힘 대구시장 후보는 4일 대구 수성구 선거사무실에서 한겨레와 한 인터뷰에서 ‘경제’를 여러 차례 강조하면서 현장에서 보수층이 모이는 것을 체감한다고 했다. 추 후보는 더불어민주당이 발의한 조작기소 특검법에 대해 “오만함이 하늘을 찌른다. 반드시 국민이 엄중한 심판을 할 것”이라고 했다. 상대인 김부겸 민주당 후보에 대해서는 “총리일 때 대구에 해놓은 게 없다”고 일갈했다.)

item.title: 'Opposition Alliance' Provoked by Fabricated Indictment Special Counsel Law..."Democratic Candidates, State Your Position" (‘야권 연대’ 자극한 조작기소 특검법…“민주 후보자들, 입장 밝혀라”)
item.description:
Conservative opposition parties have sharpened their stance against the ruling party by holding a joint meeting triggered by the Democratic Party's proposal of the 'Special Counsel Act for Investigating the Truth Behind the Yoon Seok-yeol Regime's Fabricated Indictments' (Fabricated Indictment Special Counsel Act). Through an all-out offensive on the Fabricated Indictment Special Counsel Act, they are seeking to shift the electoral landscape ahead of the June 3 local elections, where they have been at a disadvantage. (보수 야당들이 더불어민주당의 ‘윤석열 정권 조작기소 진상규명 특검법안’(조작기소 특검법) 발의를 계기로 연석회의를 열며 정부 여당에 각을 세웠다. 이들은 조작기소 특검법 총공세를 통해 열세였던 6·3 지방선거 판세 변동을 꾀하고 있다.)

People Power Party Seoul mayoral candidate Oh Se-hoon and Incheon mayoral candidate Yoo Jeong-bok, along with Reform Party Gyeonggi governor candidate Cho Eung-cheon and Seoul mayoral candidate Kim Jeong-cheol, held an 'Emergency Joint Meeting of Metropolitan Area Regional Leaders Candidates to Prevent Judicial Insurrection' at the National Assembly on the 4th. They stated, "President Lee Jae-myung must declare, 'There will absolutely be no withdrawal of the indictment regarding my charges during my term, and I will stand trial according to the law and principles.'" They added, "For candidates in the local elections to remain silent on this matter is an act of historical dereliction of duty," and demanded, "Democratic Party Seoul mayoral candidate Jeong Won-oh, Incheon mayoral candidate Park Chan-dae, and Gyeonggi governor candidate Choo Mi-ae should immediately announce a clear position on the special counsel act." (국민의힘 오세훈 서울시장 후보, 유정복 인천시장 후보와 개혁신당 조응천 경기지사 후보, 김정철 서울시장 후보는 4일 국회에서 ‘사법내란 저지를 위한 수도권 광역단체장 후보자 긴급 연석회의’를 열고 “이재명 대통령은 ‘임기 중 나의 혐의에 대한 공소 취소는 절대 없으며 법과 원칙에 따라 재판을 받겠다’고 선언하라”고 말했다. 이들은 “지방선거 후보자들이 이 사태에 입을 닫는 건 역사적 직무유기”며 “민주당 정원오 서울시장 후보, 박찬대 인천시장 후보, 추미애 경기지사 후보는 특검법에 대한 명확한 입장을 즉각 발표하라”고 요구했다.)

This joint meeting came about after candidate Cho Eung-cheon proposed it the previous day, with People Power Party candidates agreeing to participate. (이날 연석회의는 전날 조응천 후보가 제안하고 국민의힘 후보들이 응하면서 이뤄졌다.)

Candidate Cho stated, "The arrogant and reckless Lee Jae-myung regime has united the metropolitan area candidates." Regarding President Lee's message that "the ruling Democratic Party should decide on specific timing and procedures through gathering public opinion and deliberation," Oh Se-hoon told reporters after the meeting, "This is not a matter to be resolved by asking the public or the party for opinions. The president's duty is to urge the Democratic Party to withdraw the bill." (조 후보는 “오만하고 무도한 이재명 정권이 수도권 후보들을 하나로 뭉치게 했다”고 말했다. 오세훈 후보는 회동 뒤 기자들과 만나 ‘구체적인 시기와 절차에 대해서는 여당인 민주당이 국민적 의견 수렴과 숙의 과정을 거쳐 판단해달라’는 이 대통령 메시지에 대해 “국민이나 당의 의견을 물어서 처리할 사안은 아니다”라며 “법안을 철회하도록 민주당에 촉구하는 것이 대통령이 해야 할 일”이라고 말했다.)

Candidate Yoo Jeong-bok said, "This meeting must not be a one-time event. Metropolitan area opposition candidates should form a front to defend the rule of law through joint statements and schedules." The Reform Party indicated it is open to continued joint action with the People Power Party. Leader Lee Jun-seok told reporters, "If People Power Party leader Jang Dong-hyuk wants to discuss party-level strategies with the Reform Party, I am willing to have a dialogue." Separately, the People Power Party has also escalated its offensive. (유정복 후보는 “만남이 일회성으로 끝나면 안 된다. 수도권 야권 후보들이 공동 성명과 일정을 통해 법치주의 수호 전선을 만들어야 한다”고 말했다. 개혁신당은 향후 국민의힘과 공동 대응을 이어갈 용의가 있다고 했다. 이준석 대표는 기자들에게 “국민의힘 장동혁 대표가 당 차원 투쟁 방안을 개혁신당과 논의하겠다면 대화할 생각이 있다”고 말했다. 이와는 별도로 국민의힘도 공세 수위를 높였다.)

On the same day, Leader Jang Dong-hyuk criticized on Facebook President Lee's remark that "the ruling Democratic Party should decide on specific timing and procedures through gathering public opinion and deliberation" regarding the Fabricated Indictment Special Counsel Act, saying, "This is an admission that it is a 'Lee Jae-myung-ordered legislation.' Lee commits the crime, and the party does the cleanup—the division of labor is exactly 'gangster style.'" People Power Party Busan mayoral candidate Park Hyung-joon and other People Power Party-affiliated candidates for the five metropolitan mayoral positions in the Yeongnam region are also planning to hold an emergency press conference on the 6th to denounce the Fabricated Indictment Special Counsel Act. (장동혁 대표도 이날 페이스북에 이 대통령이 조작기소 특검법에 대해 “구체적인 시기와 절차에 대해서는 여당인 민주당이 국민적 의견 수렴과 숙의 과정을 거쳐서 판단해달라”고 한 것에 대해 “‘이재명 하명 입법’임을 자백한 것이다. 죄는 이재명이 짓고, 설거지는 당에서 하고, 업무 분담이 딱 ‘조폭 스타일’”이라고 비판했다. 박형준 국민의힘 부산시장 후보 등 국민의힘 소속 영남 5개 광역단체장 후보들도 오는 6일 조작기소 특검법을 규탄하는 긴급 기자회견을 할 예정이다.)

Reporter Yoo Young-jae young@hani.co.kr (유영재 기자 young@hani.co.kr)

item.title: North Korean Women’s Football Team to Arrive in South Korea on 17th… First Visit by North Korean Athletes in 8 Years (북한 여자축구단, 17일 한국 온다…8년 만의 북한 선수들 방문)
item.description:
North Korea’s women’s football club, “Naegohyang Women’s Football Team” (Naegohyang Football Team), will visit South Korea to participate in the Asian Football Confederation (AFC) Women’s Champions League. This marks the first time North Korean sports athletes will set foot on South Korean soil in about 7 years and 5 months, since the 2018 PyeongChang Winter Olympics. (북한의 여자 축구 클럽 ‘내고향여자축구단’(내고향축구단)이 아시아축구연맹(AFC) 여자챔피언스리그에 출전하기 위해 한국을 방문한다. 북한 스포츠 선수가 남한 땅을 밟게 되는 건 평창겨울올림픽이 열렸던 2018년 이후 약 7년5개월 만이다.)

The Ministry of Unification and the Korea Football Association announced on the 4th that the visit of Naegohyang Football Team, which will face Suwon FC Women in the semifinals of the 2025~2026 Asian Women’s Champions League, has been confirmed. The Asian Football Confederation informed the football association on the 1st that the Naegohyang Football Team’s participation in the match was confirmed. The presidential office issued a statement on the same day, saying, “We welcome the participation of the Naegohyang Women’s Football Team in the semifinal of the AFC Women’s Champions League,” and added, “The government will cooperate with the AFC and Suwon FC to ensure the team can compete well.” (통일부와 대한축구협회는 4일 2025~2026 아시아 여자 챔피언스리그 4강전에서 수원FC 위민과 대결하는 내고향축구단의 방한이 확정됐다고 밝혔다. 아시아축구연맹은 지난 1일 축구협회에 내고향축구단의 경기 참가가 확정됐다고 알려왔다. 청와대는 이날 입장문을 내어 “내고향여자축구단의 아시아축구연맹 여자챔피언스리그 준결승 경기 참가를 환영한다”며 “정부는 아시아축구연맹, 수원FC와 함께 선수단이 경기를 잘 치를 수 있도록 협조해 나가겠다”고 밝혔다.)

Naegohyang Football Team is scheduled to arrive at Incheon International Airport on the 17th via a flight from Beijing, China. The Ministry of Unification stated that a delegation of 39 people, including 27 athletes and 12 support staff, will visit South Korea. The Ministry of Unification and the football association are processing certification documents and administrative procedures for approving the visit of the North Korean athletes, and together with the AFC, are commencing on-site support for safety, including an inspection visit to the stadium. So far, the North Korean side has not requested a closed-door match. It is reported that Kim Il-guk, Chairman of the North Korean Football Association and Minister of Sports, met with AFC President Salman bin Ibrahim Al Khalifa at the AFC Congress held in Vancouver, Canada, late last month. It is reported that Minister Kim is not included in the visiting delegation list. (내고향축구단은 오는 17일 중국 베이징에서 항공편을 이용해 인천국제공항에 도착할 예정이다. 통일부는 선수 27명과 지원 인력 12명 등 선수단 39명이 방한할 예정이라고 밝혔다. 통일부와 축구협회는 북한 선수들의 방문 승인을 위한 증명서류 및 행정 절차를 밟고, 아시아축구연맹과 함께 경기장 실사 방문을 비롯해 안전을 위한 현장 지원에 착수한다. 현재까진 북한 쪽에서도 무관중 경기를 요청하지 않았다고 한다. 김일국 북한 축구협회장 겸 체육상은 지난달 말 캐나다 밴쿠버에서 열린 아시아축구연맹 총회에서 살만 빈 이브라힘 연맹 회장과 만난 것으로 전해졌다. 방한 선수단 명단에 김 체육상은 포함되지 않은 것으로 전해졌다.)

While the visit of North Korean athletes amid strained inter-Korean relations is welcome, the general view is that the likelihood of it leading to a resumption of dialogue is low. A Ministry of Unification official said in a briefing on the same day, “We will do what the government needs to do, but we will communicate and cooperate as much as possible, respecting that this is an international event,” adding, “We place significance on ensuring this event starts well and will do our part to set a good precedent.” (남북 관계가 경색된 가운데 이뤄지는 북한 선수들의 방문은 반가운 일이지만, 이를 계기로 대화가 재개될 가능성은 낮다는 것이 일반적인 시각이다. 통일부 관계자는 이날 브리핑에서 “정부가 해야 할 일을 하되 최대한 국제대회라는 점을 존중하면서 소통하고 협력하겠다”며 “이 행사가 잘 시작돼야 한다는 데 의미를 두고 좋은 선례를 만들기 위해 역할을 다할 것”이라고 말했다.)

Sports exchanges between the two Koreas, which peaked during the PyeongChang Winter Olympics, have been suspended as relations cooled. The last time a North Korean sports athlete set foot on South Korean soil was at the International Table Tennis Federation (ITTF) World Tour Grand Finals held in Incheon in December 2018. The visit of a North Korean women’s football team to South Korea is the first in 12 years, since the 2014 Incheon Asian Games. This is the first time a regional club has played a match in South Korea. Strained relations have continued since December 2023, during the Yoon Suk Yeol administration, when Kim Jong-un, General Secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea and Chairman of the State Affairs Commission, defined inter-Korean relations as “hostile two states.” Kim Seong-kyung, a professor of sociology at Sogang University, said to the Hankyoreh on the same day, “Through this opportunity, we need to think about how to reduce the ‘hostility’ in North Korea’s declared ‘two hostile state doctrine.’” (평창겨울올림픽 때 정점을 찍었던 남북 간 스포츠 교류는 양쪽 관계가 냉각기를 거치면서 잠정 중단됐다. 북한 스포츠선수가 남한 땅을 밟은 것은 2018년 12월 인천에서 열린 국제탁구연맹(ITTF) 월드투어 그랜드파이널스가 마지막이다. 북한 여자축구팀의 국내 방문으로는 2014년 인천 아시안게임 이후 12년 만이다. 지역 클럽이 한국에서 경기하는 건 처음이다. 윤석열 정부 때인 2023년 12월 김정은 조선노동당 총비서 겸 국무위원장이 남북 관계를 ‘적대적 두 국가’로 규정하면서 경색된 양쪽 관계가 이어지고 있다. 김성경 서강대 교수(사회학)는 이날 한겨레에 “이번 기회를 통해 북한이 선언한 ‘적대적 두 국가론’의 ‘적대성’을 어떻게 줄일 수 있을지 고민해볼 필요가 있다”고 말했다.)

Naegohyang Football Team, based in Pyongyang, was founded in 2012 and is sponsored by the North Korean consumer goods company Naegohyang. It is led by Ri Yu-il, a former coach of the North Korean women’s national team. A significant number of the squad consists of national-level athletes with recent experience winning age-group World Cups, and the team previously defeated Suwon FC Women 3-0 in the group stage. The semifinal match between Suwon FC Women and Naegohyang Football Team will be held on the 20th at 7 PM at Suwon Sports Complex in Jangan-gu, Suwon, Gyeonggi Province. The winner will compete for the championship against the winner of the semifinal between Melbourne City and Tokyo Verdy at the same venue on the 23rd at 2 PM. (내고향축구단은 평양에 연고를 두고 2012년 창단했으며, 북한 소비재 기업 내고향의 후원을 받는다. 북한의 전 여자 국가대표팀 감독인 리유일이 지휘한다. 선수단 상당수가 최근 연령별 월드컵 우승 경험이 있는 국가대표급 자원으로 구성됐고, 앞선 조별 예선에서 수원FC 위민을 3 대 0으로 이긴 전력도 있다. 수원FC 위민과 내고향축구단의 4강전은 오는 20일 오후 7시 경기 수원시 장안구 수원종합운동장에서 열린다. 승자는 멜버른 시티-도쿄 베르디의 4강전 승자와 23일 오후 2시 같은 장소에서 우승을 다툰다.)

item.title: "Oppa, give it a try" "Stop this and get consulting"... Democratic Party issues 'warning order' amid repeated controversies (“오빠 해봐요” “이러지 마시고 컨설팅”…민주 잇단 구설에 ‘경계령’)
item.description:
On the 4th, 30 days before the June 3 local elections and National Assembly by-elections, the Democratic Party of Korea issued a 'warning order' over mistakes by its candidates that have sparked controversy during the election campaign. (6·3 지방선거와 국회의원 재보궐선거를 30일 앞둔 4일, 더불어민주당이 선거운동 과정에서 구설에 오르는 당내 후보들의 실수에 ‘경계령’을 내렸다.)

Democratic Party leader Jung Cheong-rae repeatedly apologized at the party's Supreme Council meeting held at the Busan Port International Exhibition and Convention Center in Dong-gu, Busan, saying, "Regarding the situation during the visit to Gupo Market, I am sorry to the child and the child's parents who were hurt by becoming the center of controversy." ( 정청래 민주당 대표는 이날 부산 동구 부산항국제전시컨벤션센터에서 열린 당 최고위원회의에서 “구포시장 방문 과정의 상황과 관련해 아이가 논란의 중심에 서게 돼 상처받으셨을 아이와 아이의 부모님께 송구하다”고 거듭 사과했다.)

The previous day, at Gupo Market in Buk-gu, Jung had said to a child during a campaign support rally for Democratic Party candidate Ha Jung-woo in the Busan Buk-gu Gap by-election, "Here's Jung-woo oppa, give it a try, oppa," and Ha responded with "Oppa." In response, the Student, Parent, Teacher Human Rights Protection Solidarity filed a complaint with the Supreme Prosecutors' Office that same day against Jung and Ha on charges of emotional abuse under the Child Welfare Act. Ha had also faced criticism last month on the 29th during his first Busan schedule at Gupo Market when he was captured on camera shaking hands with a merchant and then appearing to wipe his hand. <<> Democratic Party Seoul mayoral candidate Jung Won-oh has also recently been in the spotlight. On the 25th of last month, when a merchant at Namdaemun Market in Seoul said, "Business is really slow," Jung replied, "Why is business slow with so many tourists? Consumption patterns have changed, so stop this and get some consulting," drawing criticism for a "lecturing attitude" from People Power Party Seoul mayoral candidate Oh Se-hoon. <<> With criticism emerging within the party, such as "We need to be cautious in our remarks" (from floor leader candidate Han Byeong-do) and "Mistakes can cause the conservative camp to solidify" (from Incheon Yeonsu-gu Gap National Assembly by-election candidate Song Young-gil), the Democratic Party appears to be tightening discipline. Secretary General Jo Seung-rae said at a press briefing at the National Assembly that day, "We must not let our guard down even for a moment." <<> Reporter Kim Chae-woon cwk@hani.co.kr ( 정 대표는 전날 북구 구포시장에서 하정우 민주당 부산 북갑 국회의원 보궐선거 후보 지원 유세 중 한 어린이에게 “여기 정우 오빠, 오빠 해봐요”라고 말했고, 하 후보도 “오빠”라고 반응했다. 이에 학생학부모교사인권보호연대가 이날 정 대표와 하 후보를 아동복지법상 정서적 학대 혐의로 대검찰청에 고발하기도 했다. 하 후보는 지난달 29일 첫 부산 일정으로 구포시장을 찾았다가, 상인과 악수한 뒤 손을 터는 듯한 모습이 카메라에 잡히며 비판을 받기도 했다.)

item.title: Cho Kuk: “Withdrawal of indictment against President Lee is appropriate… Let’s see who will help the government succeed” (조국 “이 대통령 공소취소 마땅…누가 정부 성공 도울지 봐달라”)
item.description:
“Is he just someone to lean on for President Lee Jae-myung, or is he someone who will help President Lee achieve greater success?” (“이재명 대통령에게 단지 기댈 사람인가, 이 대통령의 더 큰 성공을 도울 사람인가.”)

Cho Kuk, a candidate of the Cho Kuk Innovation Party, whom I met in Pyeongtaek, Gyeonggi Province on the 4th, described the meaning of the by-election for the Pyeongtaek-eul National Assembly seat in these terms. This is an appeal for voters to choose him for the success of the Lee Jae-myung administration and the victory of the broader pro-government camp in re-seizing power. Candidate Cho predicted that the Pyeongtaek-eul election, which involves a five-way race, will evolve over time into a two-way contest between him and Kim Yong-nam, the candidate of the Democratic Party of Korea. Regarding the ‘Special Counsel Act to Investigate the Truth of the Yoon Seok-yeol Administration’s Fabricated Indictment’ proposed by the Democratic Party, Candidate Cho stated, “The withdrawal of the indictment against President Lee Jae-myung is a proper conclusion,” but suggested, “Whether the special counsel act is the ‘optimal path’ to the withdrawal of the indictment should be discussed in depth after the election.” (4일 경기도 평택에서 만난 조국 조국혁신당 후보는 평택을 국회의원 재선거의 의미를 이렇게 말했다. 이재명 정부의 성공과 정권 재창출이란 범여권의 승리를 위해 자신을 선택해달라는 호소다. 조 후보는 5자구도의 평택을 선거전은 시간이 흐를수록 김용남 더불어민주당 후보와 자신 간의 양강 구도가 될 것이라고 내다봤다. 조 후보는 민주당이 발의한 ‘윤석열 정권 조작기소 진상규명 특검법’에 대해 “이재명 대통령에 대한 공소취소는 마땅한 결론”이나, “특검법이 공소취소로 가는 ‘최적 경로’일지는 선거 뒤에 심도 깊게 논의하자”고 제안했다.)

— You said you would win by a margin of three votes in a multi-candidate race. What does that mean? (―다자구도로 3표 차 승리를 하겠다고 했다. 어떤 의미인가?)

“I don’t place much significance on current opinion polls. In the end, it will become a two-way race between me and Kim Yong-nam of the Democratic Party. Even though Yoo Eui-dong of the People Power Party is a three-term lawmaker in the Pyeongtaek area, support for him—despite having no notable achievements—and for Hwang Kyo-ahn of the Freedom and Innovation Party, who defended the insurrection, will gradually decline. Since I threw my hat into the ring for Pyeongtaek-eul, I sense that public sentiment is shifting. Winning by a three-vote margin is an expression of my determination to prevail in a tight electoral contest.” (“현재 여론조사들엔 별로 의미를 두지 않고 있다. 결국엔 나와 김용남 민주당 후보의 양강 구도가 될 것이다. 평택 지역 3선 의원이지만 뾰족한 성과가 없는 유의동 국민의힘 후보, 내란을 옹호했던 황교안 자유와혁신 후보에 대한 지지는 점차 줄어들 것이다. 내가 평택을에 도전장을 낸 뒤 민심이 요동치고 있다는 것을 느낀다. 3표 차 승리는 아슬아슬한 선거전에서 반드시 승리하겠다는 결기의 표현이다.”)

— Will there be an alliance with candidate Kim Yong-nam or Kim Jae-yeon of the Progressive Party? (―김용남 후보나 김재연 진보당 후보와의 단일화는?)

“I am not considering an alliance. The Democratic Party has also repeatedly said there will be no alliance. I never expected one in the first place. It’s only natural for candidate Kim Jae-yeon of the Progressive Party to complete the race as well, isn’t it?” (“단일화를 생각하지 않는다. 민주당도 여러 차례 단일화는 없다고 얘기했다. 애초 기대하지도 않았다. 김재연 진보당 후보도 완주하는 것이 당연하지 않겠나.”)

— What will you do if elected in Pyeongtaek-eul? (―평택을에서 당선되면 무엇을 할 것인가)

“The transportation issue is the most serious. Buses come about once an hour, and the app arrival notifications are not working well. With such poor transportation, those who don’t drive or the elderly find it difficult even to leave Pyeongtaek. Just going to the hospital becomes a huge ordeal. So, I plan to extend the Shinansan Line to Anjung Station, build a complex transfer center there, and install a Bus Rapid Transit (BRT) system like in Sejong City (Osong Station).” (“교통 문제가 가장 심각하다. 버스가 1시간에 1대 정도 오고, 앱(app) 도착 알림도 잘 안돼 있다. 교통이 워낙 열악하니 차를 운전하지 않는 사람이나 고령층은 평택 밖을 나가기조차 어렵다. 병원 가는 것만도 너무 큰 일이 된다. 그래서 신안산선을 안중역까지 연장해 안중역에 복합환승센터를 건립하고, 세종시(오송역)처럼 비알티(BRT·간선급행버스체계)를 놓으려 하는 것이다.)

— You’ve been repeatedly criticizing candidate Kim Yong-nam’s past remarks (regarding the Sewol ferry disaster, the Itaewon tragedy, and the death of farmer Baek Nam-gi). Some call this negative campaigning. (―과거 김용남 후보 발언(세월호·이태원 참사, 백남기 농민 사망 관련)을 거듭 비판하고 있다. 일각에선 ‘네거티브’라고 한다.)

“All candidates should be subject to verification and evaluation. Attacking that as negative campaigning is cowardly. I hope candidate Kim will have the courage to apologize instead of avoiding the issue. I have apologized whenever I had the chance regarding the so-called ‘Cho Kuk scandal’ in 2019.” (“모든 후보는 검증과 평가를 받아야 한다. 그것을 네거티브라고 공격하는 것은 비겁하다. 김 후보가 회피하지 말고 사과할 용기를 갖길 바란다. 저는 기회가 될 때마다 2019년 이른바 조국 사태와 관련해 사과했다.”)

— Still, candidate Kim is the ruling party candidate. He’s using the slogan ‘Lee Jae-myung’s Choice.’ (―그럼에도 김 후보는 여당 후보다. ‘이재명의 선택’을 표어로 내걸고 있다.)

“That slogan itself shows that candidate Kim, without presenting his own vision and values, intends to ride on President Lee’s coattails. Even after joining the Democratic Party, candidate Kim said that the prosecution’s authority to direct investigations should be revived and made several remarks supporting supplementary investigative powers. Between him and me, who better aligns with and has actually contributed to the governance philosophy and vision of the Lee Jae-myung administration? This election is about asking which candidate will achieve the goal of the broader Democratic and progressive camp: the success of the Lee Jae-myung administration and the creation of a fifth Democratic government.” (“그 표어에서부터 김 후보가 자신의 비전과 가치를 내세우지 않고, 이 대통령에게 기대서 가겠다는 것을 보여준다. 김 후보는 민주당 입당 뒤에도 검찰의 수사지휘권을 부활시켜야 한다고 했고, 보완수사권을 옹호하는 취지의 발언을 여러 차례 했다. 그런 김 후보와 나 중에 누가 이재명 정부의 국정 철학과 비전에 더 부합하고 실제 기여해왔는가. 이번 선거는 이재명 정부의 성공과 5기 민주정부의 창출이라는 범민주·진보 진영의 목표를 이룰 후보는 누구인가를 묻는 선거다.”)

— What is your stance on the ‘Special Counsel Act for Fabricated Indictments’? (―‘조작기소 특검법’에 대한 입장은?)

“Let me first state that a withdrawal of the indictment in President Lee Jae-myung’s cases is proper. Last September, as the party’s emergency committee chair, I had already strongly argued for the withdrawal of the indictment even before the Democratic Party did. However, I plan to carefully review whether the bill contains any unconstitutional provisions and whether it is consistent with the law. I am more qualified than anyone to take on that role. One thing must be considered here. Under the current special counsel bill, if the special counsel decides to withdraw the indictment, the court must, under Article 328 of the Criminal Procedure Act, dismiss the prosecution. In that case, what would happen if the court, citing controversies over the unconstitutionality of specific provisions in the special counsel act, does not issue a dismissal ruling but instead refers the bill to the Constitutional Court? The withdrawal of the indictment must happen, but the method must be free of constitutional controversy and, as a result, avoid political and social conflict.” ( “이재명 대통령 사건들에 대한 공소취소는 마땅하다고 먼저 밝혀둔다. 지난해 9월 이미 당 비상대책위원장으로서 민주당보다도 먼저 공소취소를 강하게 주장했다. 다만 법안에 위헌적인 부분은 없는지, 법률로서 정합성이 있는지 꼼꼼히 검토할 생각이다. 그 역할을 어느 누구보다 내가 잘할 수 있다. 여기서 반드시 함께 고려해야 하는 것이 있다. 현재 특검법안에 따라 특검이 공소취소를 결정하면 형사소송법(328조)상 법원이 공소기각을 해야 한다. 이때 법원이 특검법 세부 조항에 대한 위헌 논란 등을 이유로 공소기각 결정을 않고 헌법재판소로 법안을 넘긴다면 어떻게 되겠는가. 공소취소는 해야 하지만, 그 방법은 위헌 논란이 없어야 하고, 결과적으로 정치적·사회적 갈등도 없어야 한다.” )

item.title: Kim Yong-beom: "After May 9, Housing Prices Expected to Rise Moderately… Will Strive for Supply to Prevent Panic Buying" (김용범 “5·9 이후 집값 완만 상승 전망…패닉바잉 없게 공급 노력”)
item.description:
Cheong Wa Dae Policy Chief Kim Yong-beom predicted that after May 9, when the grace period for heavy capital gains tax on multi-homeowners ends, housing prices will "rise moderately." He also emphasized that the government will "strive to ensure supply proceeds according to schedule to prevent panic buying driven by anxiety," reaffirming the pledge to supply 60,000 homes in 46 areas of the capital region as previously announced. (김용범 청와대 정책실장이 다주택자 양도세 중과 유예 조처가 끝나는 오는 9일 이후 주택가격이 “완만한 상승을 할 것”이라고 전망했다. 또 “불안 심리로 패닉바잉이 발생하지 않도록 공급 스케줄에 따라 공급이 이뤄질 수 있도록 노력하겠다”며 앞서 예고한 수도권 46곳, 주택 6만호 공급 약속을 지키겠다고 강조했다.)

At a press briefing held at Cheong Wa Dae on the 4th, Kim stated, "Some say there will be a lock-up of listings and prices will surge like in December last year to January this year, but I don't see it that way. I believe the government's stance on taxation has been communicated to some extent, so the increase will be moderate." Regarding the real estate market after President Lee Jae-myung formalized the repeal of the heavy capital gains tax grace for multi-homeowners earlier this year, Kim explained, "In areas like Gangnam's three districts and Yongsan, where many premium apartments are located, listings have significantly increased, and prices in those areas have turned downward. Historically, it's very unusual for these regions, which led the price surge, to see a decline first." (김 실장은 4일 청와대에서 기자간담회를 열어 “일각에서는 매물 잠김으로 지난해 12월~올해 1월처럼 막 올라갈 거라고 하는데 저는 그렇게 보지 않는다”며 “정부의 세제에 대한 입장이 어느 정도 전달되고 있기 때문에 완만할 것으로 본다”고 말했다. 김 실장은 올해 초 이재명 대통령이 다주택 양도세 중과 유예 폐지를 공식화한 이후 부동산 시장과 관련해서는 “강남 3구나 용산 등 프리미엄 아파트가 많이 위치한 곳의 매물이 크게 증가했고, 해당 지역의 가격은 하락으로 전환됐다”며 “그동안 가격 상승을 주도했던 이런 지역에서 먼저 하락세가 나타난 건 역사에서 볼 때 매우 이례적”이라고 설명했다.)

Kim cited figures to show that transaction volumes have also risen sharply as the incentive to sell increases ahead of the end of the heavy capital gains tax grace. Specifically, as of March 2026, the number of Seoul apartment listings by multi-homeowners reached 2,087, a 32% increase from the monthly average of 1,577 last year. He added, "An in-depth analysis of buyers showed that 73% were non-homeowners, and 45% were those aged 30 and under, who represent the future generation of the housing market. This analysis suggests some positive signs for narrowing the asset gap between generations." Regarding non-resident single-homeowners, he said, "It's natural to prevent future loans for those considered unrelated to actual demand, and we are also studying measures on how to handle loans that have already been disbursed." (김 실장은 양도세 중과 유예 종료를 앞두고 매도 유인이 커지면서 거래량도 크게 늘었다고 수치를 들어 설명했다. 구체적으론 2026년 3월 기준, 다주택자가 보유한 서울 아파트 매도 물량은 2087건으로, 지난해 월평균 1577건보다 32% 늘어난 숫자라고 밝혔다. 김 실장은 “매수자를 심층 분석했더니 무주택자가 73%”라며 “주택시장 미래세대층인 30대 이하도 45%였다. 세대 간의 자산 격차 완화에도 긍정적 패턴이 조금 보였다는 분석”이라고 부연했다. 그러면서 비거주 1주택자에 대해서는 “실수요자와 관계없다고 생각되는 부분에 대한 대출을 앞으로 못 나가게 하는 것은 당연하고, 이미 나간 걸(실행된 대출) 어떻게 할 것이냐는 방안도 연구 중”이라고 말했다.)

Kim acknowledged, "Only about half the planned construction starts occurred in 2022-2023, creating a mismatch between supply and demand. There is a challenge of managing this situation when supply cannot be controlled." He then referenced the plan to supply 60,000 homes in the capital region and stressed that consultations with relevant ministries, including the Ministry of National Defense, Ministry of Land, Infrastructure and Transport, and Ministry of Economy and Finance, are being expedited. (김 실장은 “2022~2023년에 착공이 절반 정도밖에 이뤄지지 않아 수요와 공급 간 미스매치(불균형)가 생겼다”며 “공급을 어떻게 할 수 없는 상태에서 이 상황을 관리해야 하는 난제가 있다”고도 말했다. 이어 수도권 6만호 공급 계획을 언급하고, 국방부와 국토교통부, 기획예산처 등 관련 부처 협의에 속도를 내고 있다고 강조했다.)

Additionally, Kim hinted at intentions to restructure the long-term holding special deduction to prioritize actual residence while maintaining it. He said, "The long-term holding deduction will be maintained. However, both the holding period and residence period have deduction rates of 40%, and there is consideration over whether applying them equally is appropriate, with a shift toward prioritizing actual residence." Currently, when selling a single home held for over 10 years, both the holding period deduction rate of 40% and the residence period deduction rate of 40% apply, allowing up to 80% of capital gains to be deducted. (김 실장은 아울러 장기보유특별공제는 유지하면서도 실거주 위주로 재편하겠다는 뜻을 시사했다. 김 실장은 “장특공제는 유지된다”며 “다만 거주와 보유가 똑같이 (공제율이) 40%로 돼 있는데 실거주 위주로 재편하는 데 (똑같이 적용되는 게) 맞냐는 고민이 있다”고 말했다. 10년 이상 보유한 1주택을 팔면 보유기간 공제율 40%, 거주기간 공제율 40%를 함께 적용받아 양도 차익의 80%가 공제된다.)

Reporters: Seo Young-ji yj@hani.co.kr and Go Gyeong-ju goh@hani.co.kr (서영지 기자 yj@hani.co.kr 고경주 기자 goh@hani.co.kr)

item.title: Jung Jin-suk: "Choo Kyung-ho is allowed, why not me?"... People Power Party sinking into 'Yoon Again' quagmire (정진석 “추경호는 되고 왜 나는?”…국힘 ‘윤 어게인’ 수렁)
item.description:
Controversy is growing as Jung Jin-suk, former lawmaker of the People Power Party and the final chief of staff to former President Yoon Suk-yeol, publicly rebuts internal criticism over his application for nomination in the June 3 by-election for the National Assembly. (윤석열 전 대통령의 마지막 비서실장인 정진석 국민의힘 전 의원이 자신의 6·3 국회의원 보궐선거 공천 신청을 둘러싼 당내 비판을 공개 반박하면서 논란이 커지고 있다.)

On the 4th, former lawmaker Jung wrote on Facebook, "What's happening within our party since I announced my candidacy is extremely bewildering," adding, "Not putting me through a primary is discourteous to those who support our party." (정 전 의원은 4일 페이스북에 “출마 선언 이후 우리 당 안에서 벌어지는 일, 너무 당혹스럽다”며 “저를 경선에 부치지 않는 것은 우리 당을 지지해주는 분들에 대한 예의가 아니다”라고 썼다.)

He then pointed to Choo Kyung-ho, the same party's candidate for Daegu mayor, who has been indicted on charges of engaging in important duties related to insurrection but still became the final candidate, asking, "Was there anyone who raised an objection saying this person shouldn't be nominated?" and "Shouldn't we consider fairness with other nominees linked to President Yoon?" Targeting party leader Jang Dong-hyuk, Jung also said, "Our party constitution and rules stipulate that the party leader cannot arbitrarily 'cut off' (exclude from nomination) candidates in the selection process for public office," and asked, "If you cut off Jung Jin-suk and install someone to your liking, can you win the election?" <<> On the 30th of last month, former lawmaker Jung applied for nomination in the by-election for Gongju, Buyeo, and Cheongyang in South Chungcheong Province, stating, "I don't think we should be forced to completely sever ties (with former President Yoon) on a personal level." As Jung's actions sparked controversy, the People Power Party's Nomination Management Committee postponed the nomination for the region on the 1st and convened a meeting for further discussion on this day, but failed to reach a conclusion. Committee Chairman Park Deok-heum said, "If (the party ethics committee) deems him qualified, we plan to interview (former lawmaker) Jung on the 7th and decide on the candidate." <<> Internal opposition is intensifying. Candidate Kim Tae-heum, who is seeking re-election as South Chungcheong Province governor, announced on this day that he would postpone his preliminary candidate registration and candidacy announcement. On Channel A's YouTube, he said, "If someone served as the final chief of staff in a situation where former President Yoon was impeached over martial law and the regime was lost, that person should be self-reflective." Seoul Mayor Oh Se-hoon also said on YTN Radio, "Since this election is held right after the martial law, I believe it would be beneficial for him and the party if he takes responsibility and shows restraint." <<> The Democratic Party of Korea is intensifying its offensive, calling the People Power Party "the Yoon Again Party." Democratic Party leader Chung Cheong-rae said at a field supreme council meeting in Busan on this day, "When they should be prostrating themselves in apology before the public, they are instead putting those who collaborated with Yoon in a palanquin," adding, "I hope they immediately withdraw the nominations of these accomplices to insurrection, who deserve universal scorn." <<> Reporter Kim Hae-jung sea@hani.co.kr Reporter Choi Ha-yan chy@hani.co.kr (그는 이어 내란 중요임무 종사 혐의로 기소됐음에도 최종 후보가 된 같은 당 추경호 대구시장 후보를 향해 “이분 공천하면 안 된다고 이의 제기한 사람이 누가 있었느냐”며 “윤 대통령과 연관된 다른 공천자들과의 형평을 고려해야 하는 것 아니냐”고 되물었다. 정 전 의원은 장동혁 대표를 향해서도 “당 대표가 공직 후보자 선출 과정에서 ‘컷오프’(공천배제) 마음대로 하지 못하도록, 우리 당헌 당규에 규정돼 있다”며 “정진석 컷오프 시키고, 장 대표의 입맛에 맞는 사람 꽂으면 선거에서 이길 수 있냐”고 했다.)

item.title: President Lee Appears to Ask Ruling Party to Handle 'Fabricated Indictment' Special Counsel Bill After Elections (이 대통령, 여당에 조작기소 특검법 ‘선거 이후 처리’ 요청 모양새)
item.description:
On the 4th, President Lee Jae-myung stated regarding the "Special Counsel Bill for Investigating the Truth Behind the Yoon Suk-yeol Regime's Fabricated Indictments" (Fabricated Indictment Special Counsel Bill), "As for the specific timing and procedure for handling it, I ask the ruling party, the Democratic Party of Korea, to decide after gathering public opinion and undergoing a deliberation process." This is interpreted as emphasizing the necessity of introducing a special counsel while asking the ruling party to handle the bill after the June 3 local elections. (이재명 대통령이 4일 ‘윤석열 정권 조작기소 진상규명 특검법안’(조작기소 특검법)에 대해 “구체적인 처리 시기와 절차에 대해서는 여당인 더불어민주당이 국민적 의견 수렴과 숙의 과정을 거쳐 판단해달라”고 말했다. 특검 도입의 당위성을 강조하면서도, 6·3 지방선거 뒤에 특검법을 처리해달라고 여당에 주문한 것으로 풀이된다.)

At a briefing at the presidential office that day, Senior Presidential Secretary for Political Affairs Hong Ik-pyo conveyed this, saying, "President Lee stated, 'Revealing the truth through a special counsel and establishing judicial justice is something that must be done.'" Before relaying the President's words, Secretary Hong explained, "Through the 'Parliamentary Investigation into the Truth Behind the Suspicions of Fabricated Indictments by the Yoon Suk-yeol Regime's Political Prosecutors,' a significant portion of the illegal acts and unjust investigations perpetrated by the Yoon Suk-yeol regime and political prosecutors at the time has been uncovered, and a national consensus has formed on the need for a special counsel investigation to correct this." This marks the first official statement from the presidential office on the Fabricated Indictment Special Counsel Bill since it was proposed. On the 30th of last month, the Democratic Party introduced the Fabricated Indictment Special Counsel Bill, which would allow a special counsel appointed by the president to drop charges against President Lee in cases related to the Daejang-dong development project and other matters. President Lee did not comment on the provision effectively granting the special counsel the power to dismiss indictments. (홍익표 청와대 정무수석은 이날 청와대 브리핑에서 “이 대통령이 ‘특검을 통해 진실을 규명하고 사법적 정의를 세우는 것은 반드시 해야 할 일’이라고 말했다”며 이렇게 전했다. 홍 수석은 이 대통령의 말을 전하기 전 “‘윤석열 정권 정치검찰 조작기소 의혹 사건 진상규명을 위한 국정조사’를 통해 당시 윤석열 정권과 정치검찰에 의해 자행된 불법 행위와 부당한 수사 등이 상당 부분 밝혀졌고, 이를 바로잡기 위한 특별검찰 수사의 필요성에 대해서도 국민적 공감대가 형성됐다”고 설명했다. 청와대가 조작기소 특검법에 대해 공식 입장을 밝힌 것은 법안 발의 뒤 처음이다. 민주당은 지난달 30일 대통령이 임명하는 특검이 대장동 개발 사업 등 이 대통령 관련 사건에 대해 공소 취소를 할 수 있도록 하는 조작기소 특검법을 발의했다. 이 대통령은 특검에 사실상 공소 취소 권한을 부여한 것에 관해서는 언급하지 않았다.)

Secretary Hong then conveyed regarding the handling of the Fabricated Indictment Special Counsel Bill in the plenary session: "President Lee said that the ruling party, the Democratic Party, should decide on the specific timing or procedure after gathering public opinion and undergoing a deliberation process." Amidst the Democratic Party leadership's pledge for "processing within May," concerns within the party that handling it before the local elections would negatively impact races in competitive regions like Yeongnam prompted the request for "speed control" under the guise of "gathering public opinion." The Democratic Party is expected to handle the Fabricated Indictment Special Counsel Bill after the local elections. (홍 수석은 이어 조작기소 특검법의 본회의 처리에 관해서는 “구체적 시기나 절차에 대해서는 여당인 민주당이 국민적 의견 수렴과 숙의 과정을 거쳐 판단해달라고 이 대통령이 말씀했다”고 전했다. 민주당 지도부가 ‘5월 내 처리’를 공언한 가운데, 당내에서도 지방선거 전 처리는 영남권 등 접전 지역 선거에 악영향을 끼칠 것이라는 우려가 나오자 “국민적 의견 수렴”을 이유로 ‘속도 조절’을 요청한 것이다. 민주당은 조작기소 특검법을 지방선거 이후 처리할 것으로 예상된다.)

The People Power Party reacted strongly. Leader Jang Dong-hyuk criticized on his Facebook page, "President Lee only said to deliberate on the 'timing' and 'procedure.' It's an order not to touch the 'content.' This is an admission that it's 'legislation by Lee Jae-myung's order.'" (국민의힘은 강력하게 반발했다. 장동혁 대표는 자신의 페이스북에 “(이 대통령이) ‘시기’와 ‘절차’만 숙의하라고 했다. ‘내용’은 건드리지 말라는 명령”이라며 “‘이재명 하명 입법’임을 자백한 것”이라고 비판했다.)

Reporter Seo Young-ji yj@hani.co.kr Reporter Go Kyung-joo goh@hani.co.kr (서영지 기자 yj@hani.co.kr 고경주 기자 goh@hani.co.kr)

item.title: U.S. Launches ‘Operation Freedom’ in Hormuz… Seoul Says “Maintaining Close Communication with U.S.” (미 ‘호르무즈 프리덤’ 작전에…정부 “한미 긴밀한 소통 유지”)
item.description:
In response to the United States launching ‘Operation Freedom’ on the 4th to assist ships in exiting the Strait of Hormuz, the South Korean government stated that it is monitoring the situation while maintaining communication with the U.S. (미국이 4일 호르무즈해협에서 선박이 빠져나올 수 있도록 지원하는 ‘프로젝트 프리덤’ 작전을 개시한 데 대해 정부는 한미 양국이 소통을 유지하며 상황을 주시하고 있다고 밝혔다.)

A foreign ministry official emphasized regarding the U.S. operation, “It is the government’s principle that the safety of international maritime routes and freedom of navigation align with the common interests of all nations and must be protected under international law,” and added, “Based on this, we hope that global maritime logistics networks will quickly regain stability and return to normal, and in this context, we are closely watching President Trump’s related remarks.” Earlier, President Trump announced on social media that starting from the morning of the 4th, Middle East time, he would launch ‘Operation Freedom’ to extract ships trapped in the Strait of Hormuz. (외교부 관계자는 이날 미국의 작전 개시에 대해 “국제 해상교통로의 안전과 항행의 자유가 모든 국가의 공동 이익에 부합하며 국제법상 보호되어야 한다는 게 정부의 원칙”이라는 점을 강조하며, “이를 바탕으로 글로벌 해상 물류망이 조속히 안정을 회복하여 정상화되기를 기대하고, 이런 맥락에서 트럼프 미국 대통령의 관련 언급도 주의 깊게 보고 있다”고 밝혔다. 앞서 트럼프 대통령은 에스엔에스(SNS)를 통해 중동 시각으로 4일 오전부터 호르무즈해협에 갇힌 선박을 빼내는 작전인 ‘프로젝트 프리덤’을 시작하겠다고 밝혔다.)

The foreign ministry official stressed, “Between South Korea and the U.S., we are maintaining close communication on the stable use of key maritime routes, including the Strait of Hormuz.” (외교부 관계자는 “한미 간에는 호르무즈해협을 포함한 주요 해상교통로의 안정적 이용 문제에 대해 지속적으로 긴밀한 소통을 유지하고 있다”고 강조했다.)

On the same day, Iran’s Pars News Agency reported that after the U.S. began Operation Freedom, a U.S. Navy frigate attempting to pass through the Strait of Hormuz was hit by two Iranian missiles in the Gulf of Oman and retreated. However, the U.S. Central Command, which oversees the Middle East, refuted this on X, stating, “Fact check. U.S. Navy warship has not been struck. U.S. forces are supporting ‘Operation Freedom’ and strengthening the maritime blockade on Iranian ports.” (이날 미국이 프로젝트 프리덤 작전을 시작한 뒤 호르무즈해협을 통과하려던 미 해군의 호위함 1척이 오만만에서 이란군의 미사일 2발을 맞고 퇴각했다고 이란 ‘파르스 통신’이 보도했다. 하지만 중동 지역을 관할하는 미군 중부사령부는 엑스(X)를 통해 “팩트체크. 미 해군의 군함이 피격당하지 않았다. 미군은 ‘프로젝트 프리덤'을 지원하고 이란 항구에 대한 해상 봉쇄를 강화하고 있다”고 반박했다.)

item.title: President Lee Delays Special Counsel on Manipulated Indictments... Blue House Says No Issue with Bill Content (시기 늦춘 조작기소 특검…청, 법안 내용엔 이상 없다는 입장)
item.description:
President Lee Jae-myung on the 4th urged the Democratic Party of Korea to “make a decision after gathering public opinion and deliberation,” effectively requesting that the “Special Counsel Bill to Investigate the Truth Behind the Yoon Seok-yeol Regime’s Manipulated Indictments” (Special Counsel on Manipulated Indictments) be handled after the June 3 local elections—likely due to concerns over its negative impact on competitive races in the Yeongnam region and the Seoul metropolitan area. However, the Blue House took the stance that “a public consensus has been formed on the need for a special counsel investigation” and that there is no issue with the bill’s content. <<> The Blue House had kept its distance after the Manipulated Indictment Special Counsel Bill was proposed on the 30th of last month under the leadership of the Democratic Party, stating it was “a matter for the National Assembly to discuss.” Yet, as candidates from the People Power Party and the Reform Party in the metropolitan area joined forces for a unified response, and concerns within the Democratic Party mounted that it could negatively affect elections in the metropolitan area and competitive Yeongnam races, President Lee appears to have stepped in personally to clarify his position. <<> Kim Bu-gyeom, the Democratic Party’s candidate for mayor of Daegu, held a press conference at his election office in Daegu that day and said, “If we consider the situation of candidates working hard in difficult regions, the central party should always keep this in mind when proposing such bills or stating their positions.” This followed his remarks the previous day, where he said, “If you don’t intend to abandon your comrades who are struggling and running hard, I ask you to be cautious.” He reiterated his concerns. Fellow party lawmakers Kwon Chil-seung and Im Mi-ae posted messages in the party’s group Telegram chat, stating, “Since this could affect elections in the Yeongnam region, the bill should be handled after the local elections.” Another Democratic Party lawmaker from the metropolitan area told The Hankyoreh, “I’m not sure about the metropolitan area, but it might impact elections in Daegu or Busan. If so, it’s right to wait until the elections are over.” A Blue House official told The Hankyoreh, “The President’s remarks were meant for the party to make a political judgment so as not to burden the local elections.” <<> As President Lee called for a slowdown on the Manipulated Indictment Special Counsel Bill, the party is expected to postpone its handling until after the local elections. Han Byeong-do, a former floor leader likely to be re-elected in the Democratic Party’s floor leader election on the 6th of next month, said in a phone call with The Hankyoreh, “The illegality and injustice of the political prosecution’s manipulated indictments have already been exposed, and a public consensus has been formed through parliamentary investigations. The principle that we must uncover the truth through a special counsel to restore judicial justice remains unchanged,” but added, “Since various opinions are emerging, including within the party, we will make a decision after going through a sufficient process of deliberation and discussion.” <<> While emphasizing that the introduction of a special counsel is essential, the Blue House refrained from commenting on the authority to withdraw indictments included in the bill. This can be interpreted as the Blue House effectively accepting the authority to withdraw indictments. It marks a notable contrast from November last year, when the Democratic Party pushed for a bill to suspend trials, which could stop the trial of a sitting president, and Chief of Staff Kang Hoon-sik publicly drew a line, saying, “Do not drag the president into political strife.” <<> The Manipulated Indictment Special Counsel Bill proposed by the Democratic Party grants the special counsel the authority to withdraw indictments in 12 cases, including 8 cases related to President Lee, such as the Daejang-dong development scandal, the Ssangbangwool North Korea remittance case, and the Seongnam FC sponsorship controversy. A Blue House official said, “The necessity of the special counsel bill has been acknowledged.” <<> The Democratic Party leadership also emphasized the need for the Manipulated Indictment Special Counsel Bill that day. Representative Jeong Cheong-rae said at the party’s on-site Supreme Council meeting at the Busan Port International Exhibition and Convention Center in Dong-gu, Busan, “The prosecutorial misconduct aimed at fabricating crimes targeting President Lee Jae-myung is too numerous to list one by one. The special counsel on manipulated indictments is a process of judicial normalization to correct the errors of the Yoon Seok-yeol’s prosecutorial dictatorship. Turning a blind eye to legitimate damage relief because of the president’s status goes against the spirit of the constitution.” <<> Reporter Seo Young-ji yj@hani.co.kr Reporter Kim Chae-woon cwk@hani.co.kr (이재명 대통령이 4일 더불어민주당을 향해 “국민적 의견 수렴과 숙의 과정을 거쳐 판단해달라”며 사실상 6·3 지방선거 뒤 ‘윤석열 정권 조작기소 진상규명 특검법안’(조작기소 특검법) 처리를 요청한 것은 영남과 수도권 접전 지역 선거에 미칠 악영향을 우려했기 때문으로 보인다. 그러나 청와대는 “특검 수사의 필요성에 대해 국민적 공감대가 형성됐다”며 법안 내용에는 이상이 없다는 태도를 보였다.)

item.title: Government "Checking whether information about South Korean ship being hit near Hormuz is true" (정부 “호르무즈 한국 선박 피격 정보, 사실 여부 확인 중”)
item.description:
The government is confirming the truth of reports that a South Korean ship was attacked on the night of the 4th, when the US launched 'Project Freedom' to allow ships to pass through the Strait of Hormuz. (미국이 호르무즈해협 선박 통과를 위한 ‘프로젝트 프리덤’ 작전을 개시한 4일 밤 한국 선박이 피격됐다는 정황이 접수돼 정부가 사실 여부를 확인중이다.)

A government official stated this day, "We are verifying the information that a South Korean ship was attacked." Initial checks have confirmed that there were no casualties among our nationals on the ship in question. (정부 관계자는 이날 “한국 선박이 피격됐다는 정보에 관해 사실 확인 중”이라고 밝혔다. 일단 지금까지 확인된 바로는 해당 선박에서 우리 국민 피해는 없는 것으로 1차 확인됐다.)

According to diplomatic sources, reports of an explosion on a South Korean ship anchored near Dubai in the Strait of Hormuz have been received, and the government is verifying the facts. A government official said, "We are checking the exact damage situation, including whether this was an accidental occurrence amid the chaotic situation near the Strait of Hormuz or whether the ship was attacked." (외교 소식통들에 따르면 호르무즈해협 두바이 인근에 정박중인 한국 선박에서 폭발 등이 일어난 정황이 접수돼 정부가 사실 여부를 확인하고 있다. 정부 관계자는 “호르무즈해협 인근이 혼란스러운 상황에서 우발적으로 일어난 일인지 피격을 당한 것인지를 비롯해 정확한 피해 상황을 확인중”이라고 말했다.)

Senior Reporter Park Min-hee minggu@hani.co.kr (박민희 선임기자 minggu@hani.co.kr)

item.title: South Korean Ship Hit in Hormuz, Explodes and Catches Fire… Government Says “No Casualties” (호르무즈 한국선박 피격돼 폭발·화재…정부 “인명 피해는 없어”)
item.description:
On the night of the 4th, the same day the United States launched "Operation Freedom" (Plan of Liberation) to facilitate the passage of ships through the Strait of Hormuz, a South Korean vessel experienced an explosion followed by a fire. While no casualties have been reported so far, the government is investigating whether this was a deliberate attack. (미국이 호르무즈해협 선박 통과를 위한 ‘프로젝트 프리덤’(해방 계획) 작전을 개시한 4일 밤 한국 선박에서 폭발과 함께 화재가 일어났다. 일단 인명 피해는 없는 것으로 파악됐지만, 정부는 고의적 공격 여부 등을 확인 중이다.)

The Ministry of Foreign Affairs announced that around 8:40 PM that evening, an explosion and subsequent fire occurred aboard the cargo ship HMM NAMU, which was anchored near the waters of the United Arab Emirates inside the Strait of Hormuz. According to the Ministry of Oceans and Fisheries, the explosion is presumed to have occurred on the port side of the engine room while the vessel was anchored outside the port limits of Umm Al Quwain. The ship, though Panamanian-flagged, is operated by a South Korean shipping company and carries six South Korean crew members and 18 foreign crew members, with no casualties reported. The Ministry of Foreign Affairs is currently verifying the cause of the explosion and fire as well as the extent of the damage. ( 외교부는 이날 저녁 8시40분께 호르무즈해협 안쪽 아랍에미리트 인근 해역에 정박 중이던 화물선 에이치엠엠 나무(HMM NAMU)호에서 폭발과 함께 화재가 발생했다고 밝혔다. 해양수산부에 따르면 움알쿠와인항 항계 밖 수역에 정박 중이던 이 선박의 기관실 좌현에서 폭발이 일어난 것으로 추정된다. 파나마 국적이지만 우리 선사가 운용 중인 이 선박에는 한국 국적 선원 6명과 외국 국적 선원 18명이 탑승 중이며, 인명 피해는 없는 것으로 파악됐다. 외교부는 폭발과 화재 발생의 원인과 구체 피해 현황 등을 확인 중이다.)

Cheong Wa Dae also stated that day, “We are confirming the cause of the fire on the vessel, and it has been verified that there are currently no casualties among the South Korean crew.” In connection with this, a senior government official said, “The vessel is believed to have been hit,” adding, “It is necessary to verify what type of weapon caused the damage and whether it was an intentional attack.” ( 청와대도 이날 “해당 선박의 화재 원인을 확인 중이며 현재 한국 승선원의 피해는 없는 것으로 확인됐다”고 밝혔다. 이와 관련해 정부 고위관계자는 “해당 선박은 피격당한 것으로 파악되고 있다”며 “어떤 무기 등으로 피해가 발생했는지 고의적 공격에 의한 것인지 등은 확인이 필요하다”고 말했다.)

A Ministry of Foreign Affairs official stated, “The government will closely communicate with relevant countries on this matter and take necessary measures to ensure the safety of our ships and crew inside the Strait of Hormuz.” It was reported that the government has requested rescue and other assistance from relevant countries, including the United Arab Emirates. ( 외교부 관계자는 “정부는 금번 사안에 대해 관련국들과 긴밀히 소통하며 호르무즈해협 내측의 우리 선박·선원의 안전을 위해 필요한 조치를 취해 나가겠다”고 밝혔다. 정부는 아랍에미리트 등 관련국에 구조 등 협조 요청을 한 것으로 알려졌다.)

According to the Ministry of Oceans and Fisheries, a total of 26 South Korean-flagged vessels are currently stranded inside the Strait of Hormuz. Among them, nine are oil tankers, and the remaining include car carriers. The number of South Korean crew members aboard South Korean-flagged ships is 123, and including 37 South Korean crew members on foreign-flagged vessels, the total number of South Korean crew members in the strait is 160. ( 해양수산부에 따르면 현재 호르무즈해협 안쪽에 발이 묶인 한국 국적 선박은 모두 26척이다. 이 가운데 유조선은 9척이며 나머지 선박들엔 자동차 운반선도 포함돼 있다. 한국 국적 선박에 승선 중인 한국인 선원은 123명이고, 외국 국적 선박에 타고 있는 한국인 선원 37명을 포함하면 해협 내 한국인 선원은 모두 160명이다.)

The attack on the South Korean ship occurred amid heightened tensions after U.S. President Donald Trump announced the launch of "Operation Freedom" to support the evacuation of ships trapped in the Strait of Hormuz, and Iran warned it would attack if U.S. forces attempted to enter the strait. The U.S. Central Command stated it would deploy guided-missile destroyers, over 100 aircraft, and 15,000 troops for Operation Freedom, which began on the morning of the 4th Middle East time (afternoon of the 4th Korea time). Around the time the U.S. launched Operation Freedom, oil tankers and cargo ships in the Strait of Hormuz were attacked, apparently by Iranian forces. The UAE Ministry of Foreign Affairs condemned the attack on an oil tanker owned by the Abu Dhabi National Oil Company (ADNOC) by two Iranian drones as a "terrorist act." ( 이날 한국 선박 피격은 도널드 트럼프 미국 대통령이 호르무즈해협에 갇힌 선박들의 대피를 지원하는 ‘프로젝트 프리덤’을 개시하겠다고 밝히고, 이란이 미군의 해협 진입 시도 땐 공격하겠다고 경고해 긴장이 고조된 가운데 발생했다. 미국 중부사령부는 프로젝트 프리덤에 유도 미사일 구축함, 100대 이상의 항공기, 병력 1만5천명을 투입하겠다고 밝히고 중동시각 기준 4일 오전(한국시각 4일 오후) 작전을 개시했다. 미국이 프로젝트 프리덤 작전을 개시하기 전후로 호르무즈해협에서는 유조선과 화물선이 이란 쪽이 가한 것으로 보이는 공격을 받았다. 아랍에미리트 외교부는 이날 아부다비국영석유공사(ADNOC) 소속 유조선을 이란의 무인기 2대가 공격했다며 “테러 행위”라고 규탄했다.)

Park Min-hee, Senior Reporter minggu@hani.co.kr Jang Ye-ji, Reporter penj@hani.co.kr Kim Ji-hoon, Reporter watchdog@hani.co.kr Seo Young-ji, Reporter yj@hani.co.kr (박민희 선임기자 minggu@hani.co.kr 장예지 기자 penj@hani.co.kr 김지훈 기자 watchdog@hani.co.kr 서영지 기자 yj@hani.co.kr)

item.title: Park Min-sik Selected as People Power Party Candidate for Busan Buk-gu Gap… Three-Way Race with Ha Jung-woo and Han Dong-hoon (국힘 부산 북갑 후보에 박민식…하정우-한동훈과 3파전)
item.description:
Former Minister of Patriots and Veterans Affairs Park Min-sik was elected on the 5th as the People Power Party candidate for the Busan Buk-gu Gap by-election, held alongside the June 3 local elections. This sets up a three-way race with Ha Jung-woo of the Democratic Party of Korea and independent former leader Han Dong-hoon. (6·3 지방선거와 함께 치러지는 부산 북갑 국회의원 보궐선거 국민의힘 후보에 박민식 전 국가보훈부 장관이 5일 선출됐다. 하정우 더불어민주당 후보, 무소속 한동훈 전 대표와 3자 구도를 형성하게 됐다.)

The People Power Party's Nomination Management Committee announced this after combining public opinion polls and party member voting results from the primary held on the 3rd and 4th, stating that Park outperformed former KBS journalist Lee Young-pung. (국민의힘 공천관리위원회는 지난 3∼4일 진행된 국민 여론조사와 당원 투표 결과를 합산한 경선에서 이영풍 전 한국방송(KBS) 기자를 앞섰다며 이렇게 발표했다.)

Candidate Park, a former prosecutor, served as a two-term lawmaker for Busan Buk-gu and Gangseo-gu Gap (18th and 19th assemblies) and was the first Minister of Patriots and Veterans Affairs under the Yoon Suk-yeol administration. (검사 출신인 박 후보는 제18·19대 부산 북·강서갑에서 재선 의원으로 일했고 윤석열 정부에서 초대 국가보훈부 장관을 역임했다.)

Within and outside the People Power Party, there are calls for a unification between Candidate Park and former leader Han Dong-hoon to secure victory in Busan Buk-gu Gap, but former Minister Park maintains the position that "there will be no unification." (국민의힘 안팎에서는 부산 북갑 승리를 위해 박 후보와 한 전 대표 간의 단일화가 필요하다는 목소리가 나오지만, 박 전 장관은 ‘단일화는 없다’는 입장이다.)

item.title: Three generals dismissed, one removed over martial law troop mobilization: Defense Ministry imposes heavy disciplinary measures (계엄군 동원 장성 3명 파면·1명 해임…국방부 중징계 단행)
item.description:
Generals suspected of mobilizing martial law troops to the National Election Commission and other locations during the December 3 insurrection have been dismissed. (12·3 내란 당시 중앙선거관리위원회 등에 계엄군 병력을 동원한 혐의를 받는 장성들이 파면됐다.)

The Ministry of National Defense announced on the 5th, "Four generals and field-grade officers indicted by the Defense Special Investigation Headquarters on charges of involvement in the December 3 insurrection have been subject to heavy disciplinary action for violating the duty to comply with laws and regulations, and the duty of good faith." Three individuals—former Brigadier General Kim Jeong-geun, former commander of the 3rd Airborne Brigade of the Special Warfare Command; former Brigadier General-designate An Moo-seong, former commander of the 9th Airborne Brigade of the Special Warfare Command; and Colonel Kim Se-woon, former commander of the Special Operations Aviation Unit—were dismissed, while Colonel Kim Sang-yong, former deputy director of the Defense Ministry's Investigation Headquarters, was removed from his position. The Defense Ministry held a disciplinary committee for these individuals on the 15th of last month. (국방부는 5일 “12·3 내란 사건에 연루된 혐의로 국방특별수사본부에서 기소한 장성·영관급 장교 4명을 법령준수의무위반, 성실의무위반으로 중징계 처분했다”고 밝혔다. 김정근 전 특전사 제3공수여단장(준장)과 안무성 전 특전사 9공수여단장(준장 진급예정자), 김세운 전 특수작전항공단장(대령) 등 3명은 파면됐고, 김상용 국방부 조사본부 차장(대령)은 해임 처분을 받았다. 국방부는 지난달 15일 이들에 대한 징계위원회를 개최했다.)

Former Brigade Commander Kim Jeong-geun is accused of deploying troops to the National Election Commission under the orders of former Special Warfare Commander Kwak Jong-geun during the martial law period. Former Brigade Commander An Moo-seong is accused of ordering 141 and 57 members of his respective units to the Election Commission's Gwanak building and the polling firm "Kkot," respectively, to occupy the buildings. Colonel Kim Se-woon is investigated for mobilizing 24 pilots from his aviation unit to deploy 12 helicopters, allowing 197 members of the 707 Special Mission Group to enter the National Assembly grounds. Former Deputy Director Kim Sang-yong is accused of organizing 100 personnel from the Defense Ministry's Investigation Headquarters into a joint anti-state force arrest team. item.title: Foreign Ministry: “All Crew on Exploded Vessel Safe… Whether It Was an Iranian Attack Must Be Investigated” (외교부 “폭발 선박 선원 모두 무사…이란 공격 여부, 조사해 봐야”)
item.description:
The Foreign Ministry announced that all Korean and foreign crew members aboard a Korean vessel that suffered an explosion and fire while anchored in the Strait of Hormuz are safe. The government decided to investigate the exact cause of the explosion after towing the vessel to a nearby port. (호르무즈해협에 정박해 있다가 폭발과 화재가 일어난 한국 선박에 있던 한국인과 외국인 선원 모두 무사하다고 외교부가 밝혔다. 정부는 인근 항구로 이 선박을 예인한 뒤 정확한 폭발 원인을 조사하기로 했다.)

On the 5th, the Foreign Ministry stated that as of the night of the 4th, all 24 crew members aboard the Korean-operated vessel HMM NAMU, including 6 Korean nationals who were on board when an explosion and fire occurred while anchored in the Strait of Hormuz, were confirmed to have suffered no harm. The fire on the vessel has been extinguished, and no additional damage has been identified. (외교부는 4일 밤 호르무즈해협에 정박해 있다가 폭발과 화재가 일어난 한국 운영 선박 에이치엠엠 나무(HMM NAMU)호에 탑승 중이던 우리 국적 선원 6명을 포함한 전체 선원 24명 모두 피해를 입지 않은 것으로 확인했다고 5일 밝혔다. 선박의 화재 진압도 완료됐고 추가 피해는 없는 것으로 파악됐다.)

At approximately 8:40 PM Korean time on the 4th, an explosion and fire occurred on a cargo ship operated by Korean shipping company HMM in waters near the United Arab Emirates (UAE) within the Strait of Hormuz. This incident took place amid a situation where the United States initiated ‘Project Freedom’ (Operation Liberation) on the night of the 4th, vowing to extricate vessels trapped in the Strait of Hormuz, and Iran, claiming a ‘ceasefire violation,’ retaliated. US President Donald Trump posted directly on Truth Social that night, stating, “Iran attacked unrelated countries, including a Korean cargo ship,” and argued, “It seems time for Korea to join this operation.” (한국 시각으로 4일 오후 8시40분께 호르무즈 해협 내 아랍에미리트(UAE) 인근 해역에서 한국 해운사 HMM이 운용하는 화물선에서 폭발·화재가 발생했다. 이번 사건은 미국이 호르무즈해협에 갇힌 선박들을 탈출시키겠다며 4일 밤 ‘프로젝트 프리덤’(해방 계획) 작전을 개시하고 이란이 ‘휴전 위반’이라고 반발하며 반격에 나서는 상황에서 벌어졌다. 도널드 트럼프 미국 대통령은 이날 밤 트루스 소셜에 직접 글을 올려 “이란이 한국 화물선을 포함해 관련 없는 국가들을 공격했다”면서 “이제는 한국이 이 작전에 참여할 때가 된 것 같다”고 주장했다.)

However, the government maintains that the exact cause of the accident, including whether it resulted from an Iranian attack, requires investigation. The Foreign Ministry stated, “Whether the vessel is capable of normal navigation is uncertain. After towing it to a nearby port, we will assess the damage and plan repairs. The exact cause of the accident can only be determined during the process of inspecting the damage after towing.” A tugboat is currently being arranged, but specific towing schedules are not yet set, suggesting it may take time for the government to officially announce the precise cause of the accident. (하지만, 정부는 이번 사건이 이란의 공격으로 인한 것인지 등 정확한 사고원인은 조사를 해야한다는 입장이다. 외교부는 “이 선박이 정상적으로 운항 가능한지 여부는 불확실한 상태이며, 인근 항구로 예인한 뒤 피해 상태 등을 확인하고 수리 예정”이라면서 “정확한 사고원인은 선박 예인 후 피해 상태를 확인하는 과정에서 파악 가능할 것”이라고 밝혔다. 현재 예인선을 수배 중이며 구체적인 예인 일정은 아직 미정인 상태여서, 정부가 정확한 사고 원인을 공식 발표하기까지는 시간이 걸릴 것으로 보인다.)

Meanwhile, the Foreign Ministry convened a meeting of the Overseas Citizens Protection Headquarters at midnight on the 5th regarding the explosion and fire incident involving the Korean vessel in the Strait of Hormuz. The meeting, chaired by Second Vice Minister Kim Jin-a, was attended by seven diplomatic missions in the Middle East and the Ministry of Oceans and Fisheries. During the meeting, Vice Minister Kim expressed deep concern that damage had occurred to a Korean vessel in the Strait of Hormuz for the first time since the outbreak of the Middle East war. He noted that while fortunately there were no casualties this time, it is necessary to identify the cause and work to prevent recurrence, emphasizing the importance of being fully prepared to take swift action whenever needed to protect the lives and safety of Korean sailors. (한편 외교부는 이번 호르무즈해협 내 한국 선박에 폭발·화재 사건에 대해 5일 0시에 재외국민보호대책본부 회의를 개최했다. 회의는 김진아 2차관 주재로 열렸으며 중동 지역 7개 공관과 해양수산부가 참석했다. 회의에서 김 차관은 중동 전쟁 발발 이후 처음으로 호르무즈해협 내에서 한국 선박에 피해가 발생한 데 대해 깊은 우려를 표했다. 이어 다행히 이번에는 인명 피해가 없었지만, 원인 파악과 함께 재발 방지 노력이 필요하다며 언제든지 한국 선원의 생명과 안전을 보호하기 위해 필요한 조처를 신속하게 취할 수 있도록 만반의 준비를 해두는 게 중요하다고 강조했다.)

Senior Reporter Park Min-hee minggu@hani.co.kr (박민희 선임기자 minggu@hani.co.kr)

item.title: Ha Jung-woo on 'Hand Wiping' Controversy: "I Personally Apologized to the Vendor… Even Received Encouragement to 'Stay Strong'" (‘손털기’ 논란 하정우 “상인분께 직접 사과…‘괜찮다’ 격려까지”)
item.description:
Ha Jung-woo, the Democratic Party of Korea candidate for Busan's Buk-gu Gap in the June 3 by-election, who recently faced controversy over 'wiping his hand after a handshake,' stated, "I personally visited the person involved to offer my greeting, and even received encouragement, with them saying, 'It's okay, do your best.'" (최근 ‘악수 뒤 손 털기’ 논란이 일었던 6·3 국회의원 보궐선거 부산 북갑 하정우 더불어민주당 후보가 “당사자분을 직접 찾아가 인사드렸고 ‘괜찮다, 열심히 해라’라는 격려까지 받았다”고 밝혔다.)

Candidate Ha said this in an interview with Busan CBS on the 4th, adding, "Since I'm new to politics, I think there are certainly areas where I fall short." <<> Previously, on the 29th of last month, after resigning from his position as Senior Presidential Secretary for AI Future Planning at the Blue House, Candidate Ha visited Gupo Market in Buk-gu, Busan, as his first schedule. During this visit, he was captured shaking hands with vendors and then rubbing his hands together or making a motion as if wiping them. As the controversy grew, Candidate Ha held a press conference the following day, explaining, "I shook hands with hundreds to nearly a thousand people for the first time. After it was all over, my hands felt numb, so I think I made an unconscious motion." <<> Candidate Ha also apologized again regarding the subsequent controversy over the so-called 'oppa remark.' He said, "I told the child and their parents that I am truly sorry; I sent a message and genuinely feel that way. In the end, I think the key is for me to pay a bit more attention, maintain a humbler attitude, take a lower stance, and focus on resolving things." On the 3rd, Democratic Party Representative Jeong Cheong-rae, while campaigning for Candidate Ha at Gupo Market, said to a first-grade elementary school girl, "What grade are you in? Try calling Jeong-woo here 'oppa'." When the child replied, "I'm in first grade," Representative Jeong said, "Here, Jeong-woo oppa," and Candidate Ha also responded with "Oppa." Afterward, the child said "Oppa," and they took a commemorative photo. <<> Regarding this, opposition figures criticized the attitude of Representative Jeong and Candidate Ha toward the child as inappropriate. That night, Representative Jeong issued a statement saying, "I am sorry to the child and their parents, who must have been hurt as the child was placed at the center of controversy." Candidate Ha also apologized to the child and their parents. <<> Meanwhile, when asked, "What do you see as the most important variable in this election?" Candidate Ha replied, "Many people see the opposition candidate unification as a variable," but added, "If I can convincingly show how the vision for Buk-gu's future over the next decade will change, I believe it could become a winning strategy regardless of unification." <<> Candidate Ha emphasized, "What's important for Buk-gu's development is not ideological values, but how we can open up the future, create progressive alternatives, and present solutions—and I think I have the greatest strength in that area. Aren't I the 'work expert' recognized by President Lee Jae-myung, and 'Ha GPT' (GPT, a nickname for Secretary Ha)?" <<> Reporter Lee Yu-jin yjlee@hani.co.kr ( 하 후보는 4일 부산 시비에스(CBS)와의 인터뷰에서 “아무래도 제가 정치가 처음이다 보니까 부족한 부분들이 틀림없이 있는 것 같다”며 이같이 말했다. )

item.title: Jang Dong-hyuk Draws Line on Alliance with Expelled Han Dong-hoon: "A Different Dimension from Other Parties" (장동혁, 제명한 한동훈과 연대 선 그어…“다른 당과는 다른 차원”)
item.description:
People Power Party (PPP) leader Jang Dong-hyuk on the 5th effectively declined a potential alliance with former leader Han Dong-hoon, who is running as an independent candidate in the Busan North Gap by-election, stating, "An alliance with a person who was expelled is clearly a matter of a different dimension than an alliance with other parties." (장동혁 국민의힘 대표가 5일 부산 북갑 국회의원 재보궐선거에 무소속 후보로 출마한 한동훈 전 대표와의 단일화에 대해 “제명했던 인사에 대한 연대는 다른 당과의 연대와는 분명히 다른 차원의 문제”라고 사실상 거부 의사를 밝혔다.)

During a press briefing held at the National Assembly, Rep. Jang said, "This was an issue where the party maintained its principles and decided on expulsion." Earlier in January, the PPP had expelled Han for allegedly damaging the party's reputation and manipulating party opinion through the so-called 'party member bulletin board incident.' Regarding Rep. Han Ji-ah, a pro-Han Dong-hoon figure who visited Busan to support the former leader, Rep. Jang said, "A person who became a member of the National Assembly after receiving the party's nomination and support from party members has a role and responsibility," adding, "We will accurately clarify the facts regarding the various situations currently unfolding and take necessary measures afterwards." However, he noted, "I have not yet ordered an investigation by the party's audit office." <<> When asked about the "low approval rating of the PPP" during the briefing, Rep. Jang countered, "That expression is very ambiguous," explaining, "Local elections are about selecting candidates in each region. More important than nationwide approval ratings are the ratings specific to each region and their trends. Assuming a blanket 'low approval rating' is difficult to accept." He also showed signs of discomfort, stating, "I cannot agree with the premise that (the internal) division started with the expulsion of Han Dong-hoon, and that it is the sole cause of all the current divisions in our party." In a telephone survey conducted by Gallup Korea from the 28th to the 30th of last month, the PPP's approval rating stood at 21%, less than half of the Democratic Party of Korea's rating (46%). By region, the PPP received lower support than the Democratic Party in all areas except Daegu and North Gyeongsang Province (for details, refer to the National Election Survey Deliberation Commission website). <<> Regarding the controversy over whether former Rep. Jeong Jin-seok, who has declared his candidacy in the Gongju, Buyeo, and Cheongyang by-election in South Chungcheong Province, will receive the party's nomination, Rep. Jang said, "We will proceed with the nomination process in a way that is acceptable to the public and ensures victory in the overall election." Earlier, the PPP's Nomination Management Committee stated on the 4th that it would postpone the decision on Jeong's nomination until after the party's ethics committee ruling. Former Rep. Jeong, who served as the chief of staff to former President Yoon Suk Yeol when martial law was declared on December 3rd, has been indicted on charges of engaging in crucial duties related to insurrection. <<> Reporter Kim Hae-jung sea@hani.co.kr (장 대표는 이날 국회에서 기자간담회를 열고 “당이 원칙을 가지고 제명했던 사안”이라며 이렇게 말했다. 앞서 국민의힘은 지난 1월 이른바 ‘당원게시판 사건’으로 당의 명예를 훼손하고 당 여론을 조작했다며 한 전 대표를 제명한 바 있다. 장 대표는 또 친한동훈계인 한지아 의원이 부산을 찾아 한 전 대표를 지원한 데 대해서 “당의 공천을 받아서 당원들의 지지를 받아서 국회의원이 된 사람의 역할과 책임이 있다”며 “지금 일어나고 있는 여러 상황에 대해서 정확하게 사실관계를 밝히고 그 이후에 필요한 조치를 하겠다”고 했다. 다만 일단 “당무감사실에 조사를 지시한 건 없다”고 했다.)

item.title: Song Young-gil "If My Hometown Were Busan, I'd Like to Run and Punish Him"… Han Dong-hoon "That's Just Bluster" (송영길 “고향이 부산이면 출마해 응징하고파”…한동훈 “허세”)
item.description:
Song Young-gil, the Democratic Party candidate for the by-election in Yeonsu-gu Gap, Incheon, said on the 5th, "Candidate Han Dong-hoon is active in Busan, and if my hometown were truly Busan, I would have volunteered to run there to punish him. I feel so sad watching him carry on like that." In response, Han Dong-hoon, the independent candidate for Buk-gu Gap, Busan, retorted, "A coward who can't even speak up while kowtowing to President Lee Jae-myung and just puts on a show of bravado is no match for me." <<> This back-and-forth stemmed from Song’s remarks that day on SBS’s 'Kim Tae-hyun's Politics Show' regarding the 'Special Act on Uncovering the Truth Behind the Yoon Suk-yeol Administration's Manipulated Indictments.' Song said, "I question whether there's a need to make this a point of contention in the current local elections. Elections are not a time for calm discussion, as everything turns into a political offensive, so it's not an ideal situation to discuss legislation calmly." <<> Then, on the issue of granting the special counsel the authority to dismiss indictments, he stated, "I'll look into the detailed process once I enter the National Assembly. Former Ssangbangwool Group Chairman Kim Seong-tae also received a dismissal of his indictment in court due to manipulated charges. That's because the prosecution filed a duplicate indictment to entrap candidate Lee Jae-myung." <<> In response, Han posted on Facebook, saying, "When the host asked Song for his stance on the special counsel law, he evaded the question by saying 'I'm not sure,' then suddenly turned his sword on me. He said he would 'punish' me, but I will win in Buk-gu Gap and punish the constitutional destruction of the Lee Jae-myung regime and cowardly old-style politics like Song Young-gil's." <<> Previously, in 2024, after former Chairman Kim received a guilty verdict in the first trial for violating the Foreign Exchange Transactions Act, the prosecution deemed the remittances to North Korea as third-party bribes for President Lee Jae-myung and others and filed an additional indictment against Kim. In February, the Suwon District Court dismissed the indictment due to the duplicate prosecution. <<> Reporter Lee Ji-eun jieuny@hani.co.kr (송영길 더불어민주당 인천 연수갑 보궐선거 후보가 5일 “한동훈 후보가 부산에 나와 있는데, 정말 제가 고향이 부산이었으면 자원해서 부산에 출마해 한동훈을 응징하고 싶었다”며 “저 떠들고 있는 모습이 안타까워 죽겠다”고 했다. 이에 한동훈 부산북갑 무소속 후보는 “이재명 대통령 눈치보느라 찍소리도 못하면서 허세나 부리는 비겁한 사람은 제 상대가 되지 못한다”고 맞받았다.)

item.title: Cheong Wa Dae Holds Response Meeting on ‘Hormuz Vessel’ Fire… Chaired by Chief of Staff (청와대, ‘호르무즈 선박’ 화재 대응회의…비서실장 주재)
item.description:
On the 5th, Cheong Wa Dae held a response meeting regarding the fire on our vessel in the Hormuz waters, chaired by Presidential Chief of Staff Kang Hoon-sik. (청와대가 5일 강훈식 대통령비서실장 주재로 호르무즈 해상의 우리 선박 화재와 관련한 대응회의를 열었다.)

Senior Press Secretary Kang Yoo-jung of Cheong Wa Dae stated, “A meeting chaired by the Chief of Staff to discuss the inspection and response to the vessel fire that occurred the previous day on the Hormuz waters was held from 12:30 PM today.” The meeting was attended by Kim Sang-ho, Director of the National Crisis Management Center; Lee Hyun, Maritime Affairs Secretary; and Kim Jung-woo, Director of the National Situation Room. (강유정 청와대 수석대변인은 이날 “전날 발생한 호르무즈 해상 선박 화재 관련 점검 및 대처를 논의하는 비서실장 주재 회의가 오늘 낮 12시30분부터 열렸다”고 밝혔다. 이날 회의에는 김상호 국가위기관리센터장, 이현 해수비서관, 김정우 국정상황실장 등이 참석했다.)

At around 8:40 PM on the 4th (Korean time), an explosion and subsequent fire occurred on one vessel operated by a Korean shipping company while it was anchored near the United Arab Emirates (UAE) inside the Strait of Hormuz. The Ministry of Foreign Affairs stated that day, “It has been confirmed that all 24 crew members, including six Korean sailors aboard the HMM NAMU, have suffered no harm,” adding, “The exact cause of the accident is expected to be identified during the process of inspecting the damage after the vessel is towed.” (지난 4일 오후 8시40분께(한국시각) 호르무즈해협 내측 아랍에미리트(UAE) 인근 해역에 정박 중이던 한국 선사 운용 선박 1척에서 폭발과 함께 화재가 발생했다. 외교부는 이날 “에이치엠엠 나무(HMM NAMU)호에 탑승 중이던 우리 국적 선원 6명을 포함한 전체 선원 24명 모두 피해를 입지 않은 것으로 확인됐다”며 “정확한 사고원인은 선박 예인 후 피해 상태를 확인하는 과정에서 파악 가능할 것으로 보인다”고 말했다.)

Reporter Seo Young-ji yj@hani.co.kr (서영지 기자 yj@hani.co.kr)

item.title: [Photo] Tumbling, High-Fives, and a Bustling Blue House ([포토] 텀블링에 하이파이브, 북적북적 청와대)
item.description:
On Children's Day, the 5th, President Lee Jae-myung and First Lady Kim Hye-kyung held the '104th Children's Day Blue House Invitation Event' at the presidential office. (어린이날인 5일 이재명 대통령과 김혜경 여사가 청와대에서 ‘제104회 어린이날 청와대 초청 행사’를 열었다.)

Around 200 people, including children from regions facing population decline, children from multicultural families, and children living near the Blue House along with their guardians, attended this event, which was the first since the presidential office returned to the Blue House. (대통령 집무실이 청와대로 복귀한 뒤 처음 열린 이날 행사에는 인구 소멸 지역 아동과 다문화가정 아동, 청와대 인근 거주 아동 및 보호자 등 200여 명이 참석했다.)

The participating children toured the main building of the Blue House with President Lee and the First Lady, and enjoyed various games on the green space in front of Sangchunjae, which had been transformed into a one-day playground. Here is a collection of photos from the scene sent by the Blue House press corps. (참가 어린이들은 이 대통령 부부와 함께 청와대 본관을 둘러보고, 일일 놀이터로 탈바꿈한 상춘재 앞 녹지원에서 다양한 놀이를 즐겼다. 청와대사진기자단이 보내온 현장의 사진을 모아본다.)

Lee Jung-ah, Reporter leej@hani.co.kr (이정아 기자 leej@hani.co.kr)
